gesture.initial_pose: Both hands resting near the sides of the body at hip level

movement_sequence.action: Raise the right hand from the side of the body toward the upper chest and face.
Position the raised hand in front of the lower face/chin with upright fingers and forward-facing palm.
Lower the right hand smoothly back toward the hip.
Rest beside the body in neutral standby posture.

gesture.finger_configuration: Fingers extended upright, thumb slightly abducted laterally forming open B/L posture
gesture.palm_orientation: Forward toward user/camera with slight inward tilt
gesture.facial_expression: Neutral attentive expression with subtle nod
